query:
UPDATE ship_transfers
                SET
                    ship_symbol = $1,
                    state = $2::ship_transfer_state,
                    fleet_id = $3,
                    assignment_id = $4,
                    start_system_symbol = $5,
                    end_system_symbol = $6,
                    reservation_id = $7,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = $8
